messages:
eden: HelixHealth POC - hitting 429s during authz load test and they asked for Dedicated pricing + security questionnaire status. Can we swarm?

maria: On it. Can you paste the repro steps?

eden: Repro from customer: token refresh load at ~600 rps, 429s start after ~90s. Also seeing intermittent "invalid token" errors. They're pushing a demo today.

jon: Looking at our ingress logs for org=helixhealth. Seeing gateway 429 responses with headers: `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0` and `x-rate-limit-reset: 12s`. Also a few 502s from the model backend around the same time.

jon: Example log snippet:
```
2026-03-21T17:02:14Z ingress helix-org req_id=abc123 status=429 path=/v1/generate x-rl-remaining=0 x-rl-reset=12
2026-03-21T17:02:15Z backend modelpool req_id=abc123 status=502 host=gpu-12
```

sophie: oncall here. Default per-org burst limit is 500 rps. Helix tried 600. We can do a temporary bump for the POC but need a quick approval and a rollback window. Also will keep an eye on the 502s.

anna: security - SQ is still pending. I emailed Helix's security contact this morning with the questionnaire link and asked for data residency and KMS requirements. No reply yet. They mentioned they handle PHI so KMS + audit logs are expected.

kyle: Pricing note: Dedicated baseline for their stated throughput looks like 3x A100-equivalent GPUs. I'll upload a provisional quote to the sales repo and link it here.

liz: Billing - for a short POC bump we can create a non-binding estimate. If they convert to Dedicated we'll need a signed PO for committed capacity.

maria: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) bump org rate limit to 1000 rps for 2 hours, 2) enable prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts, 3) set a fallback model to a smaller variant for overflow to avoid 502 cascades.

jon: To bump org limit (temporary) run:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/orgs/helixhealth/rate_limit \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY' \
  -d '{"burst":1000,"window_seconds":3600}'
```

I'll queue that now.

devops-bot: Rate-limit update job queued (job_id=rl-20260321-77).
devops-bot: Rate-limit update job rl-20260321-77 completed successfully.

sophie: Confirmed bump applied at 17:05 UTC. Monitoring: 0 429s in the last 5m, but auth failures still ~1% (invalid token). Looks like client-side token expiry mismatch.

eden: Customer says their token TTL is 60s and their refresh thread occasionally lags under load. They can increase TTL but want us to be tolerant as well.

maria: Short-term workaround: 1) ask Helix to extend token TTL to 120s for the demo, 2) we add a 10s clock-skew tolerance on our auth validation for POC orgs. I'll open an internal ticket for the tolerance change.

jon: Internal ticket created: INC-2345 - auth-clock-skew-tolerance for org helixhealth (includes logs and sample requests).

anna: Security side: if they require KMS + audit retention, Hosted can support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own KMS) and syslog export. If they insist on on-prem Private, that's a different onboarding (SOW + 3 week timeline). I requested confirmation on which they prefer.

kyle: Timeline options: Hosted + temporary org bumps + KMS BYOK -> ~3-5 business days to finalize. Dedicated + full SOC2/SOW/KMS -> ~3 weeks.

eden: They want a formal quote today to share with procurement. @kyle can you send provisional quote?

kyle: Sending provisional quote to this thread and to Eden's email. Link: https://sales.redwood.ai/quotes/quote-helix-20260321 (provisional, subject to PO).

liz: I'll generate a short-term estimate and email them by EOD. If they sign a PO we can lock the Dedicated capacity.

sophie: Handoff checklist for Sales -> Enterprise ops: 
1) Confirm PO/estimate signed
2) Security questionnaire completed and KMS decision recorded
3) Confirm desired capacity & region
4) Schedule Dedicated provisioning + IP allowlist if needed
5) Billing & legal SOW

eden: OK — I'll relay the checklist to the customer and ask for preferred KMS option and whether they can extend token TTL during the demo.

maria: I'll follow up on the tolerance change and the caching toggle. Jon please monitor model backend 502s; if they reappear we'll roll fallback model sooner.

jon: Will do. Adding extra logging to the model pool and queue length alerts for this org.

anna: I'll ping their security contact again and offer a short call with our security engineer.

eden: Thanks team. Please keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
